edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into _owner in the constructor.
Constructor receives the deploying msg.sender as owner.
bakePizza mints to _msgSender().
privateBake authenticates and mints for _msgSender().
withdrawFunds transfers the contract balance to msg.sender.
Caller address is forwarded to mintInternal as recipient.
burnForMint requires ownerOf(_tokenId) == msg.sender and burns from msg.sender.
_msgSender() is forwarded as operator to onERC721Received.
bakePizza delegates minting to mintInternal.
privateBake delegates minting to mintInternal.
bakeReservedPizza delegates minting to mintInternal.
giveAwayPizza delegates minting to mintInternal.
burnForMint calls mintInternal after burning.
mintInternal calls hash for every minted token.
mintInternal calls _mint for every token in the loop.
hash calls rarityGen for each of the nine digits.
tokenURI calls hashToSVG to embed the image.
tokenURI calls hashToMetadata for the attributes.
tokenURI reads the token hash through _tokenIdToHash.
_tokenIdToHash reads tokenIdToHash mapping.
burnForMint calls _transfer to the dead address.
transferFrom calls _transfer after approval checks.
safeTransferFrom routes to _safeMint/_safeTransfer path.
_safeMint calls _mint before the receiver check.
_safeMint performs the receiver check.
withdrawFunds sends ETH to msg.sender, an external account, enabling reentrancy.
_mint performs _balances[to] += 1.
_transfer performs _balances[to] += 1.
_transfer performs _balances[from] -= 1.
_burn performs _balances[owner] -= 1.
bakeReservedPizza performs RESERVED -= _amount.
giveAwayPizza performs RESERVED -= _amount.
privateBake performs RESERVED -= 1.
setReserved overwrites the RESERVED counter state.
bakePizza enforces totalSupply + _quantity <= MAX_SUPPLY - RESERVED.
bakePizza reads RESERVED when bounding the public supply.
bakePizza requires !_paused before minting.
privateBake checks and decrements RESERVED.
privateBake reads and clears _techTaliaWhitelist.
mintInternal writes hashToMinted to mark hashes used.
mintInternal writes tokenIdToHash for each token.
hash increments SEED_NONCE each iteration.
hash reads hashToMinted to detect duplicates.
hash consumes block.timestamp as randomness entropy.
hash builds keccak256 randomness from block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call to the receiver contract.
_msgSender() is the operator argument of the receiver callback.
mapLTN writes the letterToNumber mapping.
hashToSVG reads letterToNumber to decode pixel coordinates.
hashToSVG reads traitTypes arrays for pixels and names.
hashToMetadata reads traitTypes for trait names and types.
isWhitelisted reads _techTaliaWhitelist.
addTraitType pushes new entries into traitTypes.
clearTraits deletes traitTypes entries.
clearSpecificTrait deletes a traitTypes array.
updateWhitelist writes _techTaliaWhitelist.
pause writes the _paused flag.
setReserved writes the RESERVED state variable.
bakeReservedPizza reads and updates RESERVED.
giveAwayPizza reads and updates RESERVED.
_quantity drives payment and supply checks in bakePizza.
_quantity controls the mint loop bound.
_to receives every minted token in mintInternal.
_amount bounds the reserved supply used by bakeReservedPizza.
_amount bounds the reserved supply used by giveAwayPizza.
_tokenId identifies the token burned in burnForMint.
_hash is decoded into trait indices by hashToSVG.
_hash is decoded into trait indices by hashToMetadata.
_newReserved is assigned to the RESERVED counter.
index selects which traitTypes array is deleted.
whitelist addresses are marked true in _techTaliaWhitelist.
val is written into the _paused state variable.
_traitTypeIndex selects the traitTypes array appended to.
_randinput is compared against TIERS bounds in rarityGen.
_rarityTier selects the TIERS row in rarityGen.
currentHash accumulates the generated digits inside hash.
thisTokenId is the per-iteration token id minted.
_totalSupply caches totalSupply for the mint loop.
currentLowerBound accumulates TIERS weights in rarityGen.

normalization_plan.reason: _quantity is the user-controlled mint quantity that drives all bakePizza supply and payment checks.
_to is only used as the mint recipient inside mintInternal.
_amount is the reserved mint quantity checked against RESERVED in bakeReservedPizza.
_tokenId is only used to identify and burn the caller owned token.
_hash is decoded by hashToSVG to build the on-chain image.
_newReserved is directly assigned to the RESERVED state variable by setReserved.
index selects the traitTypes array deleted by clearSpecificTrait.
whitelist addresses are written into the _techTaliaWhitelist mapping.
val is directly stored into the _paused state variable.
_traitTypeIndex selects the traitTypes array that is appended to.
_randinput is compared against TIERS bounds to produce the trait digit.
_rarityTier selects which TIERS row is scanned.
currentHash is the accumulator built during the hash generation loop.
thisTokenId is the per-iteration token id used for minting and hash storage.
_totalSupply caches totalSupply() for the mintInternal loop.
currentLowerBound accumulates TIERS weights within rarityGen.
